settings.sceneContext: I want to understand the behavior of vehicles in my parking lot ensuring they are safe and flow is smooth.
This is our loading dock and I'm primarily concerned with worker productivity vs. just sitting around and socializing.
We want to focus on the health and safety of our patrols in this scene.
Motorcycle Engine assembly. The worker must never strike the engine with their hand to seat parts together.

prompts.name: Safety Gear Analyzer
prompts.prompt: Detect the absence of required safety gear. All workers must have on safety goggles and gloves.

prompts.name: Safety Detector
prompts.prompt: Detect any safety issues that might impact individuals or property. Detail any activities and request action that could be taken to ensure safety.

prompts.name: Red Packages
prompts.prompt: Detect the presence of reddish tone parcels in the scene.

prompts.name: Backyard Monitor
prompts.prompt: I want to detect suspicious activities outside of our family home.

prompts.name: Package Jam Alert
prompts.prompt: Detect any interruptions to regular package flow

prompts.name: SOP Monitor
prompts.prompt: Motor assembly comprises of many steps, but after the gasket is placed, the motor must be sprayed off with an air gun before the top is placed. Alert if this doesn't happen.
